note: WAEC Marketing Paper 1 round 1 (Round 16e): the WASSCE syllabus with FRESH angles - Nigerian brand scenarios (Indomie pack sizes, Dangote umbrella brand, N999 psychological pricing, Lagos trade fair, pump price regulation), a new digital-marketing topic (SEO, WhatsApp business catalogues, promoted posts, cart-abandonment emails, Google Business profiles, viral content) and question-form stems - because the near-dup scan checks every item against the JAMB, WAEC and NECO banks INCLUDING the JAMB Commerce marketing items (003, 031) and the 60-item NECO Marketing bank. Topics: marketing concepts, the marketing mix, segmentation, product and branding, pricing, distribution channels, promotion and selling, digital marketing, research and consumer behaviour.
